1.text: Yosefu ategeka igisonga cye ati “Nimwuzuze amasaho y'abo bagabo ihaho ringana n'iryo bashobora kujyana, ushyire n'ifeza y'umuntu mu munwa w'isaho ye.

2.text: Ushyire n'igikombe cyanjye cy'ifeza mu munwa w'isaho y'umuhererezi, ushyiranemo n'ifeza ye yahahishaga.” Abigenza uko Yosefu yamutegetse.

3.text: Bukeye hamaze kubona, abo bagabo basezeranwa n'indogobe zabo.

4.text: Bavuye mu mudugudu bataragera kure, Yosefu abwira igisonga cye ati “Haguruka ukurikire ba bagabo, nubageraho ubabwire uti ‘Ni iki gitumye mwitura inabi uwabagiriye neza?

5.text: Icyo mwibye si cyo databuja anywesha, kandi si cyo yikingira aragura? Ubwo mwakoze mutyo, mwakoze icyaha.’ ”

7.text: Baramubwira bati “Databuja, ni iki kikuvugishije amagambo ameze atyo? Ntibikabeho ko abagaragu bawe dukora ibimeze bityo.

8.text: Dore ifeza twasanze mu minwa y'amasaho yacu twarazigushubije, tuzivanye mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni. None twabasha dute kwiba ifeza cyangwa izahabu byo mu nzu ya shobuja?

9.text: Uwo uri bukibonane wo mu bagaragu bawe yicwe, natwe duhinduke imbata zawe, databuja.”

10.text: Arababwira ati “Nuko rero bibe nk'uko mubivuze. Uwo kiri bubonekeho ni we uri bube imbata yanjye, namwe ntimuri bugibweho n'urubanza.”

11.text: Barihuta barururutsa, umuntu wese ahambura isaho ye,

12.text: arasaka ahēra ku mpfura ageza ku muhererezi, cya gikombe kiboneka mu isaho ya Benyamini.

13.text: Bashishimura imyambaro yabo, umuntu wese ahekesha indogobe ye imitwaro, basubira mu mudugudu.

14.text: Yuda na bene se bagera mu nzu ya Yosefu, basanga akiri aho bamwikubita imbere.

15.text: Yosefu arababaza ati “Icyo mukoze icyo ni igiki? Ntimuzi yuko umuntu umeze nkanjye ashobora kuragura koko?”

16.text: Yuda aramusubiza ati “Databuja, turagusubiza iki? Turavuga iki? Turireguza iki? Imana yamenye gukiranirwa kw'abagaragu bawe. Dore turi imbata zawe databuja, twe n'uwo cya gikombe kibonetseho.”

17.text: Aramusubiza ati “Ntibikabeho ko ngira ntyo: uwo igikombe kibonetseho ni we uri bube imbata yanjye, ariko mwe mwigendere mujye kwa so amahoro.”

18.text: Yuda aramwegera aramubwira ati “Databuja, ndakwinginze, jyewe umugaragu wawe reka mvugire ijambo mu matwi yawe, uburakari bwawe bwe kugurumanira umugaragu wawe, kuko uhwanye na Farawo rwose.

19.text: Databuja, ntiwabajije abagaragu bawe uti ‘Muracyafite so, cyangwa hari undi mwene so mufite?’

20.text: Natwe tukagusubiza databuja tuti ‘Dufite data w'umusaza, hariho n'umwana yabyaye ashaje aracyari muto, mukuru we yarapfuye, ni we usigaye ari ikinege mu nda ya nyina, se aramukunda.’

21.text: Maze ukabwira twe abagaragu bawe uti ‘Muzamunzanire murebe.’

22.text: Tukakubwira databuja tuti ‘Uwo muhungu ntiyasiga se, yamusiga se yapfa.’

23.text: Nawe ukabwira twe abagaragu bawe uti ‘Umuhererezi wanyu nimutamanukana, ntimuzongere kunca iryera.’

24.text: “Nuko tuzamutse tugeze kuri data, umugaragu wawe, tumubwira amagambo yawe databuja.

25.text: Data aratubwira ati ‘Nimwongere musubireyo, muduhahireyo utwo kurya.’

26.text: Turamusubiza tuti ‘Ntitwasubirayo. Umuhererezi wacu nitujyana tuzamanuka tujyeyo, kuko tutabasha guca uwo mugabo iryera, umuhererezi wacu tutari kumwe.’

27.text: Data, umugaragu wawe aratubwira ati ‘Muzi yuko umugore wanjye twabyaranye abahungu babiri,

28.text: umwe akamvaho nkibwira ndashidikanya yuko yatanyaguwe n'inyamaswa nanjye nkaba ntakimubona,

29.text: nimunkuraho n'uyu akagira ibyago, muzatuma imvi zanjye zimanukana ishavu zijya ikuzimu.’

30.text: “Nuko none najya kuri data umugaragu wawe tutari kumwe n'uwo muhungu,

31.text: data akabona tutazanye yapfa, kuko ubugingo bwe bwiboshye ku bw'uwo muhungu, twebwe abagaragu bawe tukaba dutumye imvi za data umugaragu wawe, zimanukana ishavu zijya ikuzimu.

32.text: Kuko jyewe umugaragu wawe nishingiye uwo muhungu kuri data nti ‘Nintamugushyikiriza, nzaba ngukoreye icyaha data, kitazamvaho iteka.’

33.text: Nuko none ndakwinginze, databuja, jyewe umugaragu wawe ngume mu cyimbo cy'uwo muhungu ndi imbata yawe, kandi uwo muhungu atahane na bene se.

34.text: Nasubira nte ngo njye kuri data, ntari kumwe n'uwo muhungu? Ne kureba ibyago bizagera kuri data.”
